sections.title: World Cup 2026 Semi-final: Spain vs. France Showdown

items.headline: European Giants Clash for a Spot in the Final
items.body: Spain and France, two of Europe's footballing powerhouses, are set to face off in a highly anticipated World Cup 2026 semi-final. This match pits Spain's possession-based football against France's potent counter-attacking prowess. Both teams have demonstrated exceptional form throughout the tournament, making this a compelling encounter.

sections.title: Road to the Semi-finals: Dominant Paths

items.headline: Spain's Unbeaten Run to the Final Four
items.body: Spain has showcased impressive form, securing a 3-0 victory against Austria in the Round of 32, followed by a tight 1-0 win over Portugal in the Round of 16. They then overcame Belgium with a 2-1 scoreline in the quarter-finals to reach this stage. La Roja also won the Euro 2024 title, highlighting their strong recent performances.

items.headline: France's Relentless March Through the Knockouts
items.body: France has also enjoyed a strong World Cup campaign, defeating Paraguay 1-0 in the Round of 16 and then securing a 2-0 victory against Morocco in the quarter-finals. Les Bleus entered the tournament as one of the favorites, boasting a squad rich in world-class talent.

items.headline: Spain Holds Edge in Overall Head-to-Head Record
items.body: In 38 previous meetings, Spain leads the head-to-head record with 18 wins compared to France's 13, with 7 draws. Their most recent clash was a dramatic 5-4 victory for Spain in the June 2025 Nations League semi-final.

items.headline: Recent Competitive History Favors La Roja
items.body: Spain has won three of the last four meetings between the nations, including a 2-1 comeback in the Euro 2024 semi-finals. However, France emerged victorious in their only previous World Cup encounter, a 3-1 win in the 2006 Round of 16.

items.headline: Mbappé vs. Yamal: A Generational Wing Battle
items.body: The match will feature a captivating duel between France's Kylian Mbappé and Spain's Lamine Yamal, both exceptional wingers. Mbappé has been in remarkable form at this World Cup, leading France's attack with 8 goals and 3 assists. Yamal, at just 18, was central to Spain's Euro 2024 title and brings pace and unpredictability.

items.headline: Midfield Maestros: Rodri vs. Tchouaméni
items.body: The midfield battle will be crucial, with Spain's Rodri anchoring their possession game against France's Aurélien Tchouaméni. Rodri, a Ballon d'Or winner in 2024, is considered one of the best defensive midfielders globally. Tchouaméni provides a strong defensive shield and ball progression for France.

items.headline: Creative Forces: Olise and Pedri
items.body: France's Michael Olise has been a key playmaker, providing five assists in the tournament and forming a strong partnership with Mbappé. For Spain, Pedri is a creative engine in midfield, whose vision and passing range are vital for controlling matches.

items.headline: Spain's Possession-Based, Vertical Play
items.body: Under Luis de la Fuente, Spain continues its tradition of possession-based football, emphasizing positional play, triangles, and control of tempo. They blend this with greater verticality, looking to play in behind defenses more often. Spain also employs a high pressing tactic to quickly regain possession.

items.headline: France's Fluidity and Explosive Counter-Attacks
items.body: Didier Deschamps' France prioritizes defensive solidity combined with quick vertical passes to fast forwards like Mbappé and Dembélé. They utilize a flexible approach, transitioning between formations and creating overloads, particularly on the left side. Mbappé often plays a 'rest attack' role, maintaining a high and wide position to exploit space on counter-attacks.

sections.title: The Stakes: A Place in the World Cup Final

items.headline: One Step Away from World Cup Glory
items.body: For both Spain and France, this semi-final represents the penultimate hurdle to lifting the coveted World Cup trophy. A victory here would secure a spot in the final, offering a chance at ultimate international football glory. The pressure will be immense as both nations vie for a place in history.
